html: I bought Michael A. Covington's latest book, "Digital SLR Astrophotography", on amazon.ca. I mostly bought this book because I'm just starting out in this hobby. I received my copy just before Christmas. After a first quick read, I'm happy with it. All aspects of astrophotography with a DSLR are covered and the author generously shares his personal experience in the field. The advice on choosing lenses and on digital processing is very enlightening. It came out very recently, so the book is very up to date.
